Street View Imagery à 360° sur Google Maps : Mieux représenter Maurice sur la carte

📅 2026-07-22 ✍️ Olivia Edouard / L'Express Maurice 🏷️ Google Maps, Street View, Mauritius, MTPA, World Travel in 360, tourism mapping, digital visibility, privacy
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

Mauritius has launched a professional Street View 360° imagery campaign on Google Maps, closing a significant gap in the island nation's digital visibility that had left it among the rare tourist destinations without professional street-level imagery on the platform.

📌 Key takeaways

  • Mauritius was one of the few major tourist destinations lacking professional Street View imagery on Google Maps, limiting its digital visibility
  • The campaign is conducted by World Travel in 360, a Google-approved Street View partner, with logistical support from the Mauritius Tourism Promotion Authority (MTPA)
  • Four vehicles equipped with ultra-high-definition 360° cameras are capturing images of public roads, tourist attractions, historical sites, and coastal routes from July 19 to August 21
  • All imagery will comply with Google's privacy standards, with faces and license plates automatically blurred before publication
  • Beyond tourism promotion, the data could serve urban planning, infrastructure management, environmental monitoring, and emergency response
